text: 【周六重大事件汇总】商务部回应美制裁中国企业：敦促美方尽快纠正错误做法；何立峰与美国财政部长贝森特、贸易代表格里尔举行视频通话；“天宫”将迎首位外籍航天员，巴基斯坦载荷专家参加神舟二十四号任务……
text_en: [Summary of Major Events on Saturday] The Ministry of Commerce responds to U.S. sanctions on Chinese companies: urges the U.S. side to correct its wrong practices as soon as possible; He Lifeng holds a video call with U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent and Trade Representative Greer; "Tiangong" to welcome its first foreign astronaut, with a Pakistani payload specialist participating in the Shenzhou-24 mission...
